content.Title: 2018 Bradycardia Guideline

Sections.5.3.2: Acute Management of Reversible Causes of SND
Sections.5.3.3.1-5.3.3.50: Various studies and case reports on sin node dysfunction, atrial fibrillation, effects of medications, bradycardia, and related conditions.

Key Points: Investigation of reversible causes of sinus node dysfunction including hypothyroidism, electrolyte imbalances, and medications.
Importance of identifying and managing underlying causes for improving outcomes.
Medication effects on conduction systems and their potential risks.
